Scholarship schemes of the Example State Education Department

The department runs several schemes for school students. This page has been redesigned and the scheme details are now listed in a table further down.

Pragati Scholarship for Girls: open to girls studying in Class 11 at a government school in the state. Each selected student receives Rs. 10,000 per annum.

Merit Scholarship for Class 9: students of either gender studying in Class 9 who scored well in Class 8 may apply.
